info.name: ScanDock WMS API
info.description: Regression collection for the ScanDock warehouse API. Run it top to bottom (Collection Runner or Newman): "00 Setup" signs in and stores tokens, later folders chain ids through collection variables. Generated from scripts/build-postman.ts; edit that file, not this one.

exec: // Make single requests runnable out of order: give them a run id if the setup folder has not.

item.name: 00 Setup
item.description: Health check, demo-data reset and the two sessions every later request relies on.

exec: // A fresh run id keeps every SKU / bin / order number unique, so the collection can be run again and again.
pm.test('test hooks are enabled (needed for the reset below)', () => pm.expect(body.testHooks).to.eql(true));

request.description: Only exists when the API runs with TEST_HOOKS=true. Rebuilds the seed so expected numbers are stable.

item.name: 02 Master data
item.description: Items and bins used by the rest of the run (REQ-004..006).

exec: pm.test('details name sku, name and weightLb', () => pm.expect(paths).to.include.members(['sku', 'name', 'weightLb']));
pm.test('flagged low stock (0 <= reorder point 1)', () => pm.expect(body.lowStock).to.eql(true));
pm.test('every row is PICKING', () => body.data.forEach(b => pm.expect(b.zone).to.eql('PICKING')));
pm.test('our new bin is listed', () => pm.expect(body.data.map(b => b.code)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('pickBin')));

item.name: 03 Receiving
item.description: PO lifecycle: OPEN -> PARTIAL -> RECEIVED, with the over-receipt and lot rules (REQ-009..013).

item.name: Receiving into a SHIPPING bin is refused
Create PO for the lot-tracked item
Lot-tracked receipt without a lot is 400

exec: pm.test('lot kept on the receipt', () => pm.expect(body.lines[0].lot).to.eql('LOT-' + pm.variables.get('runId')));
pm.test('4 of our item in storage', () => pm.expect(mine.qtyOnHand).to.eql(4));
pm.test('10 on hand in total', () => pm.expect(body.qtyOnHand).to.eql(10));

item.name: 04 Picking and shipping
item.description: SO lifecycle: OPEN -> PICKING -> PICKED -> SHIPPED (REQ-014..018).

item.name: SO detail suggests the picking bin first

exec: pm.test('first suggestion is the PICKING bin', () => pm.expect(body.lines[0].suggestions[0].bin).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('pickBin')));

item.name: Shipping suggestion for 200 lb to Canada

exec: pm.test('weight from the picked lines', () => pm.expect(body.weightLb).to.eql(6));

item.name: 05 Transfers
item.description: Bin-to-bin moves and their ledger rows (REQ-019, REQ-023).

item.name: More than the bin holds is 409
Ledger has an OUT and an IN row for the transfer

exec: pm.test('one TRANSFER_OUT and one TRANSFER_IN', () => pm.expect(body.data.map(t => t.type).sort()).to.eql(['TRANSFER_IN', 'TRANSFER_OUT']));

item.name: 06 Cycle counts
item.description: Snapshot, blind-free count by the operator, approval by the admin (REQ-020..021).

item.name: Create count for the storage bin
Second count for the same bin is 409

exec: pm.test('posted by the admin', () => pm.expect(body.data[0].user).to.eql('Ada Admin'));

item.name: 07 ERP sync
item.description: Outbox delivery and idempotent pulls against the Nimbus ERP mock (REQ-024..025).

exec: const po = pm.collectionVariables.get('poNumber'); const so = pm.collectionVariables.get('soNumber'); const cc = 'CC-' + pm.collectionVariables.get('countId');
const mine = body.data.filter(o => o.reference.startsWith(po) || o.reference === so || o.reference === cc);
pm.test('receipts, fulfillment and adjustment were queued', () => pm.expect(mine.length).to.be.at.least(4));
pm.test('all of them are SENT with an ERP reference', () => mine.forEach(o => { pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('SENT'); pm.expect(o.erpRef).to.be.a('string'); }));
pm.test('fulfillment is there with our tracking number', () => pm.expect(mine.payload.trackingNumber).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('trackingNumber')));
pm.test('quantity matches the pick', () => pm.expect(mine.payload.lines).to.eql([{ sku: pm.collectionVariables.get('sku'), qty: 3 }]));

item.name: Create an order in the ERP
The ERP order is now a warehouse order

exec: pm.test('country and priority copied', () => pm.expect(body.country + body.priority).to.eql('CARUSH'));

item.name: Second sync does not duplicate it
Still exactly one order with that number

exec: pm.test('receipt x2, pick, transfer out/in, adjustment = 6 rows', () => pm.expect(body.data.length).to.eql(6));
pm.test('ZPL starts with ^XA and holds the bin code', () => { pm.expect(body.zpl).to.match(/^\^XA/); pm.expect(body.zpl).to.include('^FD' + pm.collectionVariables.get('bin') + '^FS'); });
pm.test('uses the UPC-A command with 11 data digits', () => pm.expect(body.zpl).to.include('^BUN'));

item.name: 09 Users
item.description: User administration and its effect on sessions (REQ-002, REQ-033).
